provenance.note: The record's closed hat: the ladder at the room's own base, its metal share and its ring the room's (`hats.metalClosed`, `hats.closedT10`), the ring longer on a harder hit. No room send: it used to declare a reverb the hat never routed, and routing one now would put a send on it the band balance was never measured with.

notes.grain: SPARK-2: the grain the room's `hats` block holds (`top`, `air`, `tail`, nought in every table; `hat-grain.ts`): metal above 8 kHz, air past the lid from `airHz`, the tail after -10 dB. A place writes them; nought builds nothing.
